title: Prescription queue partial Pharmacy Admin role has no permitted handbook route
actual: rx_queue bundle lists pharmacy_admin as a partial role and GET /prescriptions/pending permits that role. Real demo.pharmadmin returns200 for pending,403 for prescription detail (expected separate prescription.view). But GET /meta/handbook?workspace=pharmacy_admin lists only pharmacy_admin/medication_safety_setup/drug_recalls/pharmacy_storage_log and shared pages; rx_queue is absent. Our menu follows scoped handbook, so queue-only partial role cannot reach the page/F1. Full Pharmacist Pharmacy workspace includes rx_queue and works.
expected: Please clarify the intended queue-only partial Pharmacy Admin journey. If intended, add rx_queue through the permitted workspace also_uses/handbook with only GET pending and queue controls, so its required F1/help remains authorized. Otherwise document that pending is API access without a standalone queue entry for this role. We will not inject unpermitted help or grant detail access.
